# Decisions

Every idea about this book that was discussed and decided, or is still open. Review runs
read only the index (`decisions.py index`), open an entry with `decisions.py show ID`, and
never raise a DECIDED item again. `decisions.py check --fix` rebuilds the index. The format
is described in the book plugin, `lib/decisions-format.md`.
